behavior: Existing robot accounts are reactivated and saved without replacing identity or credentials. Failed Account saves restore the prior memory snapshot. A successful Account save survives a later failed Loop save.

sourceControls.scope: Exact compiled controller with controlled Account query/save seams; not a Mongo execution.

verification.originalClientScope: Account and Classic: inactive credentials denied, CreateLoop reactivates with the same identity, original credentials authenticate, and authentication survives service/store restart.

priorFocusedFailure: Existing Create relocation test incorrectly required the Account snapshot to remain unchanged after its successful save and a later Loop save failure. Replaced with explicit assertions preserving only the successful Account change.
privacy: Synthetic controls only; no live robot or household changes.
